facing.head: class
facing.src: art.draw facing (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {facing}): the side a drawn thing faces

expression.head: class
expression.src: art.draw expression (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {expression}, drawing.person.expression): a k.faces expression, or a word or k.feelings feeling that names one (figure-rules.sop)

pose.head: class
pose.src: art.draw pose (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {pose}, drawing.person.pose): a k.faces pose of the figure (figure-rules.sop)

trait.head: class
trait.src: art.draw trait (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {trait}): a k.faces trait (colours set, parts added or taken away)

wear.head: candidate
wear.src: art.draw wear (drawing.object.make / catalog.make {wear}): a k.wearables thing worn by the person made

edge.head: class
edge.src: art.draw edge (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {edge}): the side of the page a thing touches or is cut off by (occlusion-rules.sop)

cut.head: number
cut.src: art.draw cut (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {cut}): the share of the thing beyond the page edge (0 touching, 0.5 half cut off)

holds.head: candidate
holds.src: art.draw holds (drawing.object.make / catalog.make {holds}): a k.objects kind the person made holds in the hand of its pose

behind.head: fill+span
behind.src: art.draw behind (make / catalog.make / object.change {behind}): the thing in front that partly hides this one (occlusion-rules.sop)

hidden.head: number
hidden.src: art.draw hidden (make / catalog.make / object.change {hidden}): the share hidden behind the thing in front (0.5 half)

side.head: class
side.src: art.draw side (make / catalog.make / object.change {side}): where a thing peeks out from behind (left, right, top) or lies from a thing it is measured from (left, right, above, below)

offset.head: number
offset.src: art.draw offset (make / catalog.make / object.change {offset}): a measured gap from an edge (edge) or a thing (near, side), in unit

unit.head: candidate
unit.src: art.draw unit (make / catalog.make / object.change {unit}): a k.units length or one of its words (inch, hand-width, finger-width); page units when absent

grade.head: class
grade.src: art.draw grade (make / catalog.make / object.change {grade}): a distance named without a number

near.head: fill+span
near.src: art.draw near (make / catalog.make / object.change {near}): the thing a measured gap is taken from

material.head: candidate
material.src: art.draw material (make / catalog.make / object.change / part.change {material}): a k.styles material or one of its words (wooden, glass, brick)

cause.head: fill+span
cause.src: art.draw cause (make / catalog.make / object.change / person.expression {cause}): the thing an expression is about (happy because ...)

variant.head: candidate
variant.src: art.draw variant (object.change {variant}): a k.objects stand-in variant (a sports car) or another kind the thing becomes

dimension.head: span
dimension.src: the dimension a chart is broken down by ("sales by month": month); diagram.group.chart.make {dimension}, k.charts.category (data drops chart.dimension)

fontSize.src: chart group formatting in the Diagram tab (worlds/diagram.sketch/chart-format.sop; data drops dg-batch-05 frame chart.font.size)
